entities.name: Régis de Trobriand
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philippe Régis Denis de Keredern de Trobriand was a Breton aristocrat, lawyer, poet, and novelist who, on a dare, emigrated in his 20s to the United States, settling first in New York City. During the American Civil War, he became naturalized, was commissioned and served in the Union Army, reaching the rank of Major general.

entities.name: Régis de Trobriand
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philippe Régis Denis de Keredern de Trobriand was a Breton aristocrat, lawyer, poet, and novelist who, on a dare, emigrated in his 20s to the United States, settling first in New York City. During the American Civil War, he became naturalized, was commissioned and served in the Union Army, reaching the rank of Major general.
